status: Exploratory extension of an exploratory extension. Designed after v1 results were known and frozen before any v2 model execution. Not a preregistration.
rationale: v1 established descriptive effects on seven documented projects but contained no uninformative reference, no signal-loss control and no adaptation comparator, so a near-zero attribution effect could not be distinguished from an insensitive harness. v2 adds those three controls, a dimension-matched augmentation control, ten source seeds and four downstream learners.
label: RealBug
class_weight: balanced; XGBoost uses scale_pos_weight = negatives/positives computed from its own training labels

arm_definitions.shap_sum: Features multiplied by unit-sum mean absolute out-of-fold SHAP weights.
arm_definitions.uniform_sum: Features divided by the active feature count. Matches the mean multiplier magnitude of shap_sum, carries no attribution information.
arm_definitions.shuffled_sum: shap_sum weights permuted across features. Matches the multiplier distribution exactly, destroys the feature/attribution correspondence.
arm_definitions.select_shap: Top half of active features by SHAP weight.
arm_definitions.select_random: Equal-sized random subset of active features.
arm_definitions.p_aug: Original features plus the cross-fitted teacher probability.
arm_definitions.ps_aug: Original features plus the teacher probability plus one SHAP column per active feature.
arm_definitions.pn_aug: NEW. Original features plus the teacher probability plus uninformative Gaussian columns, one per active feature, so the column count equals ps_aug exactly. Each column is drawn independently from a normal distribution whose mean and standard deviation are taken from the corresponding source SHAP column. Source and target draws use a dedicated generator seeded from the run seed. Isolates an attribution-specific augmentation effect from a generic added-dimension penalty.
arm_definitions.coral: NEW. Source covariates whitened and recoloured to the pseudo-target covariance (CORAL). Documented adaptation comparator. Reads unlabelled pseudo-target covariates; the target response is never used.
arm_definitions.prevalence: NEW. Featureless reference. Constant prediction equal to the source training positive rate. Independent of the downstream learner by construction; identical values across model cells are expected and asserted.
arm_definitions.permuted_original: NEW. Original features, but downstream training labels are permuted within each source project so per-project class counts are preserved. Tuning also uses the permuted labels. Scored against true target labels. Measures whether the harness detects total source-signal loss.

tuning: Three-fold GroupKFold over source projects, ROC-AUC. Two candidates per learner, equal budget for every arm including controls. Representations and teachers are rebuilt inside each source-validation fold. 'independent' selects per arm; 'shared_baseline' reuses the arm-agnostic 'original' choice.
preprocessing: Training-median imputation and training-constant removal. LogisticRegression uses signed log then RobustScaler; tree and boosting learners use neither. Only the 54 static code metrics, excluding all defect columns, identifiers and process metrics.
target_information_boundary: Target responses enter scoring only, never fitting, tuning, imputation, feature screening, attribution construction or hyperparameter selection. The coral arm additionally reads unlabelled pseudo-target covariates and is the only transductive arm; this is disclosed wherever coral is reported.
aggregation: Within each target, average over repeats, teachers and learners as specified per table, then take the equal-target mean. Leave-one-target-out aggregation sensitivity removes each target from that aggregate in turn WITHOUT retraining and WITHOUT removing that project from the remaining targets' source pools. Repeat variability is reported separately.
inference: Descriptive fixed-benchmark effects. Target rotations share training projects, so they are not independent replications. No significance tests over overlapping seeds, no confidence intervals, no equivalence bounds, no retrospective power claim. A successful control demonstrates detectable signal loss or adaptation effect; it does not establish power to prove equivalence near zero.

sensitivity_runs.source_cap: Predeclared subset comparing 400 against 800 rows per source project, seeds 101-103, both teachers, all seven targets, all arms and both regimes. Written to a separate output directory.

learner_selection_note: The fourth learner was chosen on measured runtime before any v2 result existed. HistGradientBoosting was benchmarked at 7.7-13.0 s per fit against 0.15-0.63 s for XGBoost on the same 2400x54 and 2400x109 shapes, which made the full grid infeasible. No accuracy result influenced this choice.
